Name: EvolvingAIConversation
Author: kuanglang1234
Description:
English
Evolving AI Conversation lets you chat naturally with Stardew Valley NPCs. They remember your conversations, form impressions of you, and develop their personalities and relationships through your shared experiences.
Main features:
[list]
[*]Memory and personality growth: past experiences influence future conversations.[/*]
[*]Text and voice chat: type messages, send recordings, and hear spoken replies with individual NPC voices.[/*]
[*]Letters and gifts: NPCs can choose to write to you and include gifts.[/*]
[*]Group conversations: talk with several NPCs and let them build impressions of each other.[/*]
[*]Dates and following: invite NPCs to meet up or accompany you.[/*]
[*]Autonomous Life: enable NPCs to plan activities and seek out social interactions.[/*]
[*]In-game customization: manage personalities, memories, player impressions, and settings through F7.[/*]
[/list]Getting started:
Install the mod through SMAPI, configure your dialogue API in AI Settings, and enable your chosen NPCs. Stand near an NPC and press Q to chat, or V for voice mode.
An API key is required. Voice mode also needs a configured speech-generation service, and player recordings require a dialogue model that supports audio input.
中文
Evolving AI Conversation 让你可以和《星露谷物语》的 NPC 自由聊天。他们会记住你们的对话，形成对你的印象，并随着共同经历逐渐改变性格和关系。
主要功能：
[list]
[*]记忆与人格成长：过去的经历会影响之后的对话。[/*]
[*]文字与语音：支持打字、发送录音，以及使用 NPC 专属音色朗读回复。[/*]
[*]信件与礼物：NPC 可以自主决定写信，并附带礼物。[/*]
[*]多人对话：和多位 NPC 一起聊天，让他们形成对彼此的印象。[/*]
[*]约会与跟随：邀请 NPC 见面，或与你一起行动。[/*]
[*]自主生活：开启后，NPC 可以安排活动、寻找社交对象。[/*]
[*]游戏内调整：通过 F7 管理人格、记忆、玩家印象和各项设置。[/*]
[/list]开始使用：
通过 SMAPI 安装 Mod，在“AI 设置”中配置对话 API，启用想交流的 NPC。靠近并面对 NPC，按 Q 聊天，按 V 使用语音模式。
需要自行配置 API 密钥。语音模式还需要配置语音生成服务；发送玩家录音时，对话模型必须支持音频输入。
Q群 二9一9零9六2九 更新更快
